Show Collapsible Groups timing logs in the game log.
Useful when diagnosing slow recipe viewer startup, group rebuilds, or editor/manager refreshes.

Verify the editor preview index against a reference implementation.
Useful when testing editor-side preview correctness.

Verify the startup item-group index against a reference implementation.
Builds the reference result and compares it with the optimized startup index. This is slower, but useful for correctness testing.
collapsible_groups.configuration.default: Default Groups
Mod Integration
Load AE2 Groups

Whether to load built-in AE2 groups.
Has no effect if AE2 is not installed.
Load Apotheosis Groups

Whether to load built-in Apotheosis groups.
Has no effect if Apotheosis is not installed.
Load Chipped Groups

Whether to load built-in Chipped block-variant groups.
Has no effect if Chipped is not installed.
Load Chisel Modern Groups

Whether to load built-in Chisel Modern block-variant groups.
Has no effect if Chisel is not installed.
Load EnderIO Groups

Whether to load built-in EnderIO groups.
Has no effect if EnderIO is not installed.
Load Iron's Apothic Groups

Whether to load built-in Iron's Apothic gem groups (one group per gem type).
Has no effect if Iron's Apothic is not installed.
Load Iron's Spellbooks Groups

Whether to load built-in Iron's Spellbooks scroll groups (one group per spell).
Has no effect if Iron's Spellbooks is not installed.
Load Macaw's Series Groups

Whether to load built-in Macaw's series block-tag groups.
Has no effect if none of the supported Macaw's mods are installed.
Load Mod Integration Groups

Whether to load built-in mod-integration groups.
Groups for mods that are not currently installed are always skipped.
Load RS2 Groups

Whether to load built-in RS2 groups.
Has no effect if RS2 is not installed.
Load Rechiseled Groups

Whether to load built-in Rechiseled block-variant groups.
Has no effect if Rechiseled is not installed.

Whether to load built-in mod-integration groups.
Groups for mods that are not currently installed are always skipped.
Enable Built-in Groups

Enable grouping for all built-in group IDs, including their overrides.
Definitions and individual settings remain available when disabled.
Load Generic Groups
Whether to load built-in generic cross-mod groups (potions, enchanted books, music discs, etc.)
Load Vanilla Groups
Whether to load built-in vanilla item groupings (wool, concrete, colored glasses, etc.)
Master switch for all built-in default groups.
collapsible_groups.configuration.ui.coll:
ARGB background color for collapsed group headers.
Accepted formats: #AARRGGBB, 0xAARRGGBB, AARRGGBB, or RGB values that keep the default alpha.
collapsible_groups.configuration.ui.expa:
ARGB background color for expanded group headers and children.
Accepted formats: #AARRGGBB, 0xAARRGGBB, AARRGGBB, or RGB values that keep the default alpha.

ARGB color for the connected border around expanded groups.
Accepted formats: #AARRGGBB, 0xAARRGGBB, AARRGGBB, or RGB values that keep the default alpha.
collapsible_groups.configuration.ui.grou:
RGB color for group display names.
Alpha is ignored if an ARGB value is provided.
collapsible_groups.configuration.ui.sear:
Show small matching groups as regular ingredient entries while filtering search results.
This avoids a group header when only a few children match.

Filtered group child count must be lower than this value before search leaves it ungrouped.
For example, 5 leaves groups with 2-4 matching entries ungrouped; 0 disables this behavior.
collapsible_groups.configuration.ui.show:
Whether grouped ingredient slots draw a semi-transparent background tint.
When disabled, group backgrounds are fully transparent while the +/- indicator and borders remain visible.
Whether to show the group manager button in the ingredient list overlay.
